real_chromium.scope: signed local HTTP; in-memory DB; external requests blocked

changes.statistics: original profit calculation; server-side four-period facets; 30-second shared read cache

changes.stock_and_roles: live per request; not part of report cache
changes.buyer_counts: MongoDB returns scalar buyer counts instead of lists of all buyer IDs

changes.request_count: one existing admin/home request; no extra shell request or periodic job
changes.authentication: signed identity and current role checked on every admin request
